description:
Maher Property Advisors are delighted to present this unique and spacious four-bedroom family home located in the highly sought-after Friars Green development on the Tullow Road, Carlow.

Occupying a superb corner site overlooking a large green area, this attractive property enjoys an exceptional setting with a private rear garden that wraps around the side and rear of the house. The outdoor space is ideal for family living and entertaining, featuring two patio areas, side access, and a walled driveway to the front.

Built in 2002, Friars Green is a mature and well-established residential development conveniently located within walking distance of local primary and secondary schools, Lidl supermarket, Éire Óg GAA grounds, and Carlow Town Centre. A local bus service also stops directly outside the estate, offering excellent connectivity.

Accommodation extends to a bright and welcoming entrance hallway with tiled flooring and an under stairs guest WC. To the front of the property is a spacious sitting room featuring beautiful wooden flooring. To the rear lies a large open-plan kitchen and dining area, providing an excellent space for everyday family life. Adjacent to the kitchen is a utility room  and direct access to the rear garden and patio area. A versatile extension located off the kitchen offers additional accommodation and could be utilised as a fifth bedroom, home office, playroom, or family room.

Upstairs, the accommodation comprises a generous master bedroom to the front with fitted wardrobes and an ensuite bathroom. A further double bedroom with fitted wardrobes and ensuite is located to the rear of the property, while an additional double bedroom and single bedroom, both with fitted wardrobes, overlook the rear garden. A well-appointed family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation.

This exceptional property combines spacious accommodation, a prime location, and excellent outdoor space, making it an ideal family home in one of Carlow's most desirable residential developments.

Viewing is advised and strictly by appointment only
